scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您现在携带的物品太多了。请先将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Hello...
Not from around
here, are you?
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
你好...
你不是
本地人吧？

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
My name is Bazo Heburiech. I'm pleased to make your acquaintance. As you can see, I'm also not from around here either. I feel as if... We were meant to meet.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
我叫巴佐·赫布里奇。很高兴认识你。如您所见，我也不是本地人。我觉得...我们似乎命中注定要相遇。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
If you don't mind, let me tell you a little about this place. When I first got here, I could tell there was something different about
this village.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
如果不介意的话，让我向您介绍一下这个地方。我刚来的时候，就感觉到这个村庄有些不同寻常。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
For one thing, Umbala is close
to Niflheim, realm of the dead. Because it's so near, some of the people here can actually draw evil power from that realm.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
首先，汶巴拉靠近尼弗海姆，那是亡者的国度。因为距离很近，这里的一些人实际上能够汲取那个领域的邪恶力量。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Don't worry, the locals here only use this power to produce specialty items. During my stay here, I too have learned some of those crafting methods.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
别担心，当地人只利用这种力量来制作特色物品。在我逗留期间，我也学会了一些制作技巧。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
If you like, I'd be willing to show you my skills. Now how does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
如果您愿意，我很乐意向您展示我的技艺。您觉得如何？

scripts.text: Sounds good~
scripts.translation: 听起来不错~

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Hmm. For now, you should level
up and get stronger first. Please understand that I mean well when I say that I don't think you're quite ready for my goods.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
嗯。目前，您应该先提升等级，变得更强一些。请理解，我说您还无法驾驭我的商品，是出于好意。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Like I said before, these
goods have some evil power. If you're not strong or experienced enough, you'd be driven insane.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
正如我之前所说，这些商品带有一些邪恶力量。如果您不够强大或经验不足，可能会被其逼疯。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Once you're ready,
I'll gladly make you
something great~
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
等您准备好了，我很乐意为您打造一件杰作~

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Excellent! Let me tell you what materials I'll need. There's not that many, but you might want to write them down.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
太好了！让我告诉您需要哪些材料。数量不多，但您可能想记下来。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
First, I'll need
some basic materials.
10 Gold,
50 Steel and
10 Emperium.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
首先，我需要一些基础材料。
10个黄金，
50个钢铁，
以及10个华丽金属。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Then, I'll need some rare ore to enchant this product. The product's trait will depend on the ore that you use.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
然后，我需要一些稀有矿石来赋予这件物品属性。物品的特性将取决于您使用的矿石。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Please bring me 30 of either Citrin, Turquoise or Agate. Well then, I wish you luck in finding those things and I'll be waiting for you~
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
请给我30个黄玉、绿松石或玛瑙中的任意一种。那么，祝您寻宝顺利，我会在这里等您~

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Oh, okay.
That's fine with me.
But I'll be right here if you
ever change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
哦，好的。
那也没关系。
如果您改变主意，我就在这里。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Hmm...
I sense something different about you. I can't quite describe it, but I get the distince feeling that there's nothing I can do for you.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
嗯...
我感觉到您有些不同寻常。我很难描述这种感觉，但我隐约觉得，我似乎无法为您做什么。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
In any case, I wish you safety in your travels, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
无论如何，祝您旅途平安，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Great...!
Now, let's do this!
Oh, and you should know
now that I can't tell what kind of thing we might get. But let's hope that it'll be good.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
太好了...
好，让我们开始吧！
哦，您现在应该知道，我无法确定我们会得到什么样的物品。但希望它会很好。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou feel a mysterious energy gathering around the materials
and the air around them begins to crackle. It seems as if the materials were absorbing
all of the ambient energy.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您感觉到一股神秘能量在材料周围聚集，
周围的空气开始噼啪作响。似乎材料正在吸收
周围所有的能量。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFWithout any discernable action from Bazo, the materials began to fuse into each other.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF巴佐没有任何明显的动作，材料开始相互融合。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Can you feel that? The materials are now gathering power on their own. It's out of my hands now. All we can do now is wait and pray.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
您感觉到了吗？材料正在自行聚集力量。现在已超出我的控制范围了。我们只能等待并祈祷。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe materials finish melding
and the air grows calm.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF材料融合完毕，
空气恢复了平静。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Ooooooh! It's done!
We've succeeded! Ah,
this is amazing! Our prayers
must have been answered!
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
噢噢噢！完成了！
我们成功了！啊，
这太不可思议了！我们的祈祷
一定得到了回应！

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
It looks like all those materials turned into some kind of weapon. That ought to be quite useful to you. Now let's see...
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
看起来那些材料变成了一把武器。这应该对您很有用。让我们来看看...

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Immaterial Sword!
This sword was born to be yours!
Congratulations and hopefully it will be useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
圣剑 混沌！
这把剑天生就是为您而生的！
恭喜您，希望它能对您有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Slash!
This mace was born to be yours!
Congratulations and hopefully it will be useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
<死亡骑士>挥砍！
这件钝器天生就是为您而生的！
恭喜您，希望它能对您有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Quadrille!
This mace was born to be yours!
Congratulations and hopefully it will be useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
四重奏！
这件钝器天生就是为您而生的！
恭喜您，希望它能对您有所帮助。

scripts.text: [Bazo]
scripts.translation: [巴佐]

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Ah, I'm very satisfied with these results. If you wish to have another one, please feel free to visit me anytime. Alright then, enjoy your travels~
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
啊，我对这些结果非常满意。如果您想要再来一次，请随时来找我。那么，祝您旅途愉快~

ready so let's get started. Now, my favorite monsters are Poring, Hode, Obeaune and Minorous.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]

[Bazo]

What monster am I thinking
of right now?
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]

我现在心里想的是哪种魔物？

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Alright...
Now guess which monster
I'm thinking about right... Now!
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
好的...

scripts.text:
[Bazo]

am I thinking about?

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

我们一定漏掉了什么。

scripts.translation:

[Hibilaithan]

Never heard of me?

I mean, even though I may be a maestro at my craft, there's no need to feel intimidated.

[希比莱桑]

噢...
你的心智太弱，无法承受我作品中的力量。

Now, I'll need
10 Gold,
50 Steel and
10 Emperium
for the basic materials.

10个黄金，

awesome secrets!

scripts.translation:
[希比莱桑]
嗯？刚才说什么？
没听说过我？
拜托，别开玩笑了！
虽然我在工艺上可能是位大师，但没必要让你感到害怕。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Now be honest...
Do you want to be
the recipient of my
inspired and oft imitated
handiwork or not?
scripts.translation:
[希比莱桑]
现在老实说...
你想成为我那些灵感迸发、常被模仿的
手工制品的拥有者吗？

scripts.text: Yes. Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我想。

scripts.text: Sorry, I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不需要！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Ooh...
Your mind is too weak to handle the power of my creations. I'm sorry, but you need more training.
scripts.translation:
[希比莱桑]
噢...
你的心智太弱，无法承受我作品中的力量。
很抱歉，你需要更多的训练。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
I know it must be unbearable, waiting to own one of my creations. But for your own sake, get stronger first and then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[希比莱桑]
我知道等待拥有一件我的作品一定很煎熬。
但为了你好，先变强，然后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hahahaha!
Of course you do!
That was a rhetorical question!
But I like your attitude. Now I'm going to tell you what you need
to bring me, so don't forget.
scripts.translation:
[希比莱桑]
哈哈哈！
当然你想！
那是个修辞问句！
但我喜欢你的态度。现在我要告诉你需要带什么材料给我，别忘记了。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Now, I'll need
10 Gold,
50 Steel and
10 Emperium
for the basic materials.
scripts.translation:
[希比莱桑]
现在，我需要
10个黄金，
50个钢铁和
10个华丽金属
作为基础材料。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
I'll also need some rare ore to endow my creation with power. Muscovite, Biotite or Pyroxene. Just bring me 30 of one of those kinds of ores.
scripts.translation:
[希比莱桑]
我还需要一些稀有矿石来赋予我的作品力量。云母、黑云母或辉石。只要带给我其中一种矿石的30个即可。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Okay, I wish you good luck! In the meantime, I shall relax here and wait for your return.
scripts.translation:
[希比莱桑]
好的，祝你好运！在此期间，我会在这里放松一下，等待你的归来。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hahahahaha~!
There's no need
to be modest!
Oh, you adventurers
can be so silly sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[希比莱桑]
哈哈哈哈~！
不需要谦虚！
噢，你们冒险者
有时候真傻。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Well, if you ever muster up the courage to ask me of this favor, come back anytime. Give me the chance to show you my genius!
scripts.translation:
[希比莱桑]
好吧，如果你鼓起勇气向我提出这个请求，随时回来。给我机会展示我的天才！

scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您现在携带的物品太多了。请先将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Umba! Umbaba...umum! Baumba!
Umumumbababaumumbabaumba!
Umbaumbaumbaumbaumhah!
Umumumumumbababababab!
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
翁巴！翁巴巴...呜呜！邦翁巴！
呜呜翁巴巴翁翁巴巴翁巴！
翁巴翁巴翁巴翁巴哈哈！
呜呜呜呜翁巴巴巴巴巴！

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Hmm...
I feel something different from you. You are a stranger around here, are you not?
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
嗯...
我感觉你有些不同。你是这里的外乡人，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Allow me to introduce myself. I am Tabezthan, a veritable fountain of knowledge and a renown genius in Umbala. Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
请允许我自我介绍。我是塔贝兹桑，是汶巴拉名副其实的知识宝库和远近闻名的天才。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
I have two disciples: Hibilaithan, who is a fool, and Bazo, who is quite intelligent and shows potential.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
我有两个弟子：希比莱桑是个笨蛋，而巴佐相当聪明，很有潜力。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Of course, both are very talented and skilled, but I worry about Hibilaithan. He makes many stupid mistakes but he is fairly shameless about his errors.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
当然，两人都非常有才华和技巧，但我担心希比莱桑。他经常犯愚蠢的错误，而且对自己的错误毫不在意。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
I have taught them how to manipulate the ambient energy
here in Umbala in order to create objects. I hear that there is a similar skill in the outside world known to you as alchemy.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
我教他们如何操控汶巴拉周围的环境能量来创造物品。我听说外面的世界有一种类似的技能，你们称之为融合试验。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
In any case, do have any use
for my skills? If so, please bring me the materials that I need so that I may be of service to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
总之，你需要我的技能吗？如果需要，请带来我需要的材料，以便我为你服务。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text: No, thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
I regret to say that you are not yet capable of handling my crafts. Please train and acquire greater strength before returning to me. I wish you safety in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
很遗憾，你目前还没有能力驾驭我的作品。请去锻炼并提升实力后再回来找我。祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Good. I ask that you
remember what you need
to bring me so that I may craft something for you. I shall need...
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
很好。请记得你需要带来什么材料，以便我为你打造物品。我需要...

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
10 Gold,
50 Steel
and 10 Emperium
for the basic materials.
I'll also need a rare ore to enchant my creation.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
10个金币，
50个钢铁
和10个华丽金属
作为基础材料。
我还需要一种稀有矿石来赋予我的作品魔力。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
In addition, please bring me 30 of either Phlogopite, Peridot or Rose Quartz. Depending on the ore that you choose, my creation will possess a different trait.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
此外，请带来30块金云母、橄榄石或玫瑰石英中的任意一种。根据你选择的矿石，我的作品将拥有不同的特性。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Please be aware that I do not know exactly what item will be produced. There are too many factors in alchemy and there is a limit to anyone's knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
请注意，我不知道最终会产出什么物品。融合试验的因素太多，任何人的知识都有局限。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
In other words, we will have to trust to luck. However, we'll have time to talk about that later. For now, please go and gather the necessary materials. I shall be waiting here.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
换句话说，我们只能靠运气了。不过，我们稍后再谈这个。现在，请去收集必要的材料。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Oh... I see.
It is a little disappointing to hear that, but please return
if you believe that I can be
of service to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
哦...我明白了。
听到这个有点令人失望，但如果你认为我能为你服务，请随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Hm...?
You don't have any
business with me, do you?
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
嗯...？
你并没有什么事要找我吧？

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Please do not disregard me as merely an old fool. When a man gets older, he can see more clearly into the hearts of others. Please continue what you have been doing, and I wish you good fortune on your journeys.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
请不要把我仅仅当作一个糊涂的老头。人年纪越大，就越能看清他人的内心。请继续你正在做的事情吧，我祝你在旅途中好运。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Great, I'm ready to begin. Give me a minute to arrange these materials into a mystic circle.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
太好了，我准备好了。请给我一点时间，把这些材料排列成一个神秘的法阵。

scripts.text: ^3355FFHe arranged the materials in a strange circle and began chanting. The air around Tabezthan grew ominously heavy and the materials seemed to surge with newfound energy.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF他将材料排列成一个奇怪的圆圈，并开始吟唱。塔贝兹桑周围的空气变得沉重而诡异，材料似乎涌动着新生的能量。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Please understand that this power is not coming from me. I am merely using my skills to gather power from the realm of the dead and infusing them into these materials.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
请理解，这股力量并非来自我。我只是运用我的技巧，从亡灵界汲取力量，并将其注入这些材料中。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Let us pray for good results.
All we can do now is leave the
final result to fate.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
让我们祈祷能有好结果。
现在我们能做的，
只能将最终结果交给命运了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe materials slowly melded
into each other, combining into a completely new object. It is only
a matter of time before we learn whether you and Tabezthan have succeeded or failed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF材料缓慢地融合在一起，
结合成一个全新的物体。很快，
我们就会知道你和塔贝兹桑是成功了还是失败了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
I don't believe it!
This is such an incredibly rare weapon! Yes, I remember its name from what my late father told me. This is... Caesar's Sword!
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
难以置信！
这是一把极其稀有的武器！是的，我记得它的名字，那是已故的父亲告诉我的。这是...利剪剑！

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
I don't believe it!
This is such an incredibly rare weapon! Yes, I remember its name from what my late father told me. This is... Tirfing!
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
难以置信！
这是一把极其稀有的武器！是的，我记得它的名字，那是已故的父亲告诉我的。这是...魔刀 吞神！

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
I don't believe it!
This is such an incredibly rare weapon! Yes, I remember its name from what my late father told me. This is... Sabbath!
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
难以置信！
这是一把极其稀有的武器！是的，我记得它的名字，那是已故的父亲告诉我的。这是...安息日！

scripts.text: [Tabezthan]
scripts.translation: [塔贝兹桑]

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
This mighty weapon is yours to keep. Feel free to come back to me
if you think that I can be of service to you once again.
Farewell for now, brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
这把强大的武器归你所有。如果你认为我还能为你服务，请随时回来。
再见了，勇敢的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Shall we begin?
I will tell you the names of 4 different monsters. You will be given five chances to predict which monster I am thinking about.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
我们开始吧？
我会告诉你4种不同魔物的名字。你有5次机会来猜测我在想哪一种魔物。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
This mind reading game is an effective method of determining whether your fortune is good or bad. Get ready now...
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
这个读心游戏是判断你运气好坏的有效方法。请做好准备...

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
My favorite monsters are
Baphomet, Dark Lord, Bloody
Knight and Stormy Knight. Now,
try to guess which one I am
thinking about.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
我最喜欢的魔物是
巴风特、暗黑之王、血腥骑士
和冰暴骑士。现在，
试着猜猜我在想哪一个。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Please try to determine
which monster I'm thinking
of right this moment.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
请试着判断
我此刻正在想的是
哪一种魔物。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Now, try to sense
which monster I am
visualizing in my mind.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
现在，试着感应
我脑海中正在想象的是
哪一种魔物。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Once again, try
and guess what monster
I'm thinking about right now.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
再一次，试着
猜猜我现在正在想的是
哪一种魔物。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Alright, this is
your last chance to
correctly guess which
monster I'm thinking of.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
好了，这是你
最后一次机会
正确猜出我在想的是
哪一种魔物了。

scripts.text: [Tabezthan]
scripts.translation: [塔贝兹桑]

scripts.text: Baphomet
scripts.translation: 巴风特

scripts.text: Dark Lord
scripts.translation: 暗黑之王

scripts.text: Bloody Knight
scripts.translation: 血腥骑士

scripts.text: Stormy Knight
scripts.translation: 冰暴骑士

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
That's the end of the game. Now, this is the order of the monsters that I had in mind...
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
游戏结束了。接下来，是我心中设想的魔物顺序...

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Baphomet
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
巴风特

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Dark Lord
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
暗黑之王

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Bloody Knight
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
血腥骑士

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Stormy Knight
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
冰暴骑士

scripts.text: [Tabezthan]
scripts.translation: [塔贝兹桑]

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
You have answered {0} times correctly. It appears that your luck is at a high point, and it is an ideal time for me to craft something for you. Give me a little time to prepare, and return to me.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
你答对了{0}次。看来你的运气正处于巅峰，这正是我为你打造某物的绝佳时机。请给我一点时间准备，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Unfortunately, you weren't able to guess any of them correctly. It seems that your luck is charged with negative energy. We'll need to expel this bad luck with 10 of your Phologopite.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
很遗憾，你一次都没猜对。看来你的运气充满了负面能量。我们需要用10个云母来驱散这股厄运。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
[Tabezthan]
Umm...
You do not seem to
have enough Rose Quartz.
Please try to gather at
least 30 of them and then
return to me.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
嗯...
你的玫瑰石英似乎不够。
请至少收集30个，
然后再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
[Tabezthan]
You've returned to me earlier than I've expected. I sense that you've brought all the basic materials, but did you bring enough special ore as well?
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
你比我预期的回来得早。我感觉到你带来了所有的基础材料，但你也带了足够的特殊矿石吗？

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
[Tabezthan]
[Tabezthan]
Bring me...
10 Gold,
50 Steel
and 10 Emperium.
I'll also need a rare ore to enchant my creation.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
请带来...
10个黄金，
50个钢铁
和10个华丽金属。
我还需要一种稀有矿石来给我的作品附魔。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
[Tabezthan]
Hmm...
I feel something different from you. You are a stranger around here, are you not?
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
嗯...
我感觉你有些不同。你是这里的外乡人，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Do not be disheartened. Losing 10 {0} is much better than losing 30 on a failed crafting attempt.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
不要灰心。损失10个{0}总比在打造失败时损失30个要好得多。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Please come back with 30 Phologopite, and we shall try this mind reading game once again. I shall be waiting for you right here.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
请带着30个云母回来，我们再试一次这个读心游戏。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Umm...
You do not seem to
have enough Rose Quartz.
Please try to gather at
least 30 of them and then
return to me.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
嗯...
你的玫瑰石英似乎不够。
请至少收集30个，
然后再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
You've returned to me earlier than I've expected. I sense that you've brought all the basic materials, but did you bring enough special ore as well?
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
你比我预期的回来得早。我感觉到你带来了所有的基础材料，但你也带了足够的特殊矿石吗？

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Ah, you've brought all three. However, we can only use one kind of ore at a time, so please choose just one.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
啊，你三种都带来了。不过我们一次只能使用一种矿石，所以请只选择一种。

scripts.text: Phlogopite
scripts.translation: 云母

scripts.text: Peridot
scripts.translation: 橄榄石

scripts.text: Rose Quartz
scripts.translation: 玫瑰石英

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Hahaha, you didn't need
to bring more than one kind
of ore. Now, which one would
you like to use?
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
哈哈，你不需要带多种矿石。那么，你想使用哪一种？

scripts.text: Phlogopite
scripts.translation: 云母

scripts.text: Peridot
scripts.translation: 橄榄石

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Hahaha, you didn't need
to bring more than one kind
of ore. Now, which one would
you like to use?
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
哈哈，你不需要带多种矿石。那么，你想使用哪一种？

scripts.text: Phlogopite
scripts.translation: 云母

scripts.text: Rose Quartz
scripts.translation: 玫瑰石英

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Hahaha, you didn't need
to bring more than one kind
of ore. Now, which one would
you like to use?
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
哈哈，你不需要带多种矿石。那么，你想使用哪一种？

scripts.text: Peridot
scripts.translation: 橄榄石

scripts.text: Rose Quartz
scripts.translation: 玫瑰石英

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Good, {0}.
Now, before I can begin crafting,
I must first determine whether or not you have enough luck for me
to proceed.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
很好，{0}。
那么，在我开始制作之前，
我必须首先确认你的运气是否足够，
以便我能够继续。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
We will play a mind reading game
so that I can measure your luck and see if it is high enough to avoid the possibility of crafting failure.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
我们来玩一个读心游戏，
这样我就能测量你的运气，
看看它是否足够高，
从而避免制作失败的可能性。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
You will have 5 chances to guess which one of my four favorite monsters that I am thinking of. If you can answer correctly even just once, I can begin crafting.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
你有5次机会来猜测我正在想的
四只我最喜欢的魔物中的哪一只。
如果你能猜对哪怕一次，
我就可以开始制作了。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
However, if you answer incorrectly all five times, I must take 10 of your special ore in order to expel your misfortune.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
不过，如果你五次都猜错了，
我必须拿走你10个特殊矿石，
以驱除你的厄运。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Now, please give me a little time to finish my preparations. I shall speak to you later.
scripts.translation:
[塔贝兹桑]
现在，请给我一点时间
完成准备工作。
我稍后再与你交谈。

scripts.text:

Pyroxene and Rose Quartz. I'm sure those are the materials you need, but I have no idea what the end product is supposed to be...
scripts.translation:

嗯...
你需要30个金云母、辉石
和玫瑰石英。我确信这些是你需要的材料，
但我不知道最终成品应该是什么...

scripts.text:
[Bill Thayer]
^333333*Sniff*^000000
All of my sons passed away
before they could finish their research. I should have been the one to have died. They were still so young...
scripts.translation:
[比尔·塞耶]
^333333*吸鼻子*^000000
我的儿子们都在完成研究之前
去世了。本该死的是我。
他们还那么年轻...

scripts.text:
[Bill Thayer]
Listen, I told you...
There's nothing I can do.
^333333I'm utterly helpless here.^000000
scripts.translation:
[比尔·塞耶]
听着，我告诉过你...
我无能为力。
^333333我在这里完全帮不上忙。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bill Thayer]
There's no point in asking me to do anything. Ever since my sons passed away, I haven't been able to function. Please leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[比尔·塞耶]
让我做任何事都没有意义。自从我的儿子们去世后，我就无法正常工作了。请让我一个人待着。

scripts.text:
[Bill Thayer]
Leave me alone...
I'm just a broken old man.
scripts.translation:
[比尔·塞耶]
让我一个人待着...
我只是一个破碎的老人。

scripts.text:
[Bill Thayer]
I don't make weapons anymore for anyone. Maybe I was a well known weaponsmith once, but I just can't bring myself to do any work ever since my sons passed away...
scripts.translation:
[比尔·塞耶]
我不再为任何人打造武器了。也许我曾经是著名的武器匠，但自从我的儿子们去世后，我就无法再从事任何工作...

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
There was a skillful
weaponsmith in Al De Baran
who had 4 sons. All of them were known throughout the land for their skill in weapon crafting.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
艾尔帕兰曾有一位技艺高超的武器匠，
他有四个儿子。他们全都在武器锻造方面享有盛名。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
Tragically, all of the sons died in their attempt to create a powerful weapon. Only the father survived the accident.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
悲剧的是，所有儿子都在尝试打造强大武器时去世了。只有父亲在那次事故中幸存下来。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
Because of that incident, the weaponsmith retired and went into hiding. No one ever saw the weapon he and his sons were developing.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
因为那次事件，武器匠退休并隐居起来。没有人见过他和儿子们正在开发的武器。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
I don't think his sons
were able to peacefully enter the afterlife after sacrificing so much and having to leave their goal unfulfilled...
scripts.translation:
[市民]
我不认为他的儿子们
在牺牲了这么多，却未能实现目标后，
能平静地进入来世...

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
Meeting a person in the realm of the dead is impossible. But I've heard that if you were able to meet a dead person, you'd find that he wouldn't have all of his memories.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
在死后世界遇到一个人是不可能的。但我听说，如果你能遇到一个死去的人，你会发现他并没有保留所有的记忆。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
But if you brought him something that reminded him of his life, he'd get his memories back for a little while. Of course, you'd have to actually meet someone in the netherworld to find out for sure.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
但如果你给他带一些能让他想起生前事物的东西，他就能短暂地找回记忆。当然，你必须真的在冥界遇到某个人，才能确定这一点。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
Huh...
I know what I'm talking about might be a little morbid, but even the most trivial information might come in handy someday, right?
scripts.translation:
[市民]
嗯...
我知道我说的可能有点晦气，但哪怕是最微不足道的信息，说不定哪天也能派上用场，对吧？

scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您现在携带的物品太多了。请先将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Hey...
How did somebody like
you get all the way over here?
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
嘿...
像你这样的人，是怎么一路走到这里的？

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Just by looking at that tender face of yours, I can tell you're a little weak. You better get out of here and get real strong in a hurry before you even think of coming back.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
光看你那张稚嫩的脸，我就知道你很弱。你最好赶紧离开这里，去变得强大起来，别想着再回来了。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
In life, I was known as Kayron.
But now I'm just another ghost wandering around this realm of
the dead. Without a body, I feel
so useless.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
生前，人们叫我凯隆。
但现在，我只是在这个死后世界游荡的又一个幽灵。没有身体，我感到自己毫无用处。

scripts.text: Show interest.
scripts.translation: 表示感兴趣

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Huh...?
I can't remember what I was going to say. M-my memories! I... I can't seem to recollect...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
嗯...？
我忘了我刚才想说什么。我的...我的记忆！我...我似乎想不起来了...

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Useless...
Absolutely useless...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
毫无用处...
完全毫无用处...

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I sense something from
you. Almost as if you were
here with some sort of goal.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我感觉到你身上有某种气息。就好像你是带着某种目的来到这里的一样。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I'm surprised...
And a little envious.
It can be said that most
in Niflheim come here with
little or no purpose.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我很惊讶...
也有点羡慕。可以说，大多数来到尼弗海姆的人，几乎没有目的，或者目的很少。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Heh heh heh...
You're just in time.
The time has come for
me to reveal the results
of my work...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
嘿嘿嘿...
你来得正好。
是时候让我展示我的研究成果了...

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
It's a success!
I completed the experiment
that got me killed! I almost
can't believe it! I created
this... Great Axe!
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
成功了！
我完成了那个导致我死亡的实验！我简直不敢相信！我打造了这把...克莱伊特斧！

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
It's a success!
I completed the experiment
that got me killed! I almost
can't believe it! I created
this... Longinus's Spear!
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
成功了！
我完成了那个导致我死亡的实验！我简直不敢相信！我打造了这把...龙戚弩斯长矛！

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I'm so glad that my years of research haven't been wasted.
If only Father were able to see this, he'd be really happy for me.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我很高兴我的多年研究没有白费。
如果父亲能看到这个，他一定会为我感到高兴。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Oh no...
^333333*Sigh*^000000 I can feel my memories beginning to fade again. If you ever see me, please let me
remember my past again.
Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
糟糕...
^333333*叹息*^000000 我感觉我的记忆又开始模糊了。如果你以后见到我，请让我再次想起过去。
谢谢...

scripts.translation:

成功了！
我完成了那个导致我死亡的实验！我简直不敢相信！我打造了这把...圣光之戟！

What's this?
The stuff you're carrying
around looks awfully familiar.
Hm, let me take a look, please...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
这是什么？
你随身携带的东西看起来很眼熟。
嗯，请让我看一看...

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Yes, I was right!
I can use these to smith a weapon! How did you know these were the materials I need? In any case, this is great!
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
没错，我猜对了！
我可以用这些来锻造武器！你怎么知道这些是我需要的材料？总之，这太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Oh, but first, we need to test your luck. No matter how good my skills may be, we need to make sure your luck is good today, or else we can't proceed.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
哦，不过首先，我们需要测试一下你的运气。无论我的技术有多好，我们都必须确保你今天运气好，否则我们无法继续。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
We're gonna play '^660000Rock, Paper, Scissors^000000.' We can go ahead and
make the item if you win 2 out of 3 matches.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我们来玩“^660000石头剪刀布^000000”吧。如果你在三局中赢两局，我就可以开始制作物品了。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
But if you lose 2 out of 3, your luck isn't strong enough for me to even attempt smithing. We'll need to dump a huge amount of one of the materials you brought to repel your bad luck.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
但如果你输了两局，说明你的运气不够好，我甚至无法尝试锻造。我们需要丢弃你带来的大量材料之一，以驱散你的霉运。

[Kayron]

some of the ore you brought!
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
很遗憾，你输了。我们别无选择，
只能用你带来的一些矿石来驱散你的霉运！

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Alright, let's try this again. Go and get the materials we need
and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
好吧，让我们再试一次。去收集我们需要的材料，
然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I can't seem to recall the rest
of the materials I need. This is beginning to get really frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我似乎想不起还需要哪些材料了。这开始变得非常令人沮丧。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I mean, me and my father used to know this stuff like it was second nature. What's wrong with me...?
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我是说，我和神父以前对这些东西了如指掌。我到底怎么了...？

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Oh...!
I had no idea you were such a reliable person! You brought the things I've asked for pretty quickly!
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
哦...！
我没想到你是这么可靠的人！你很快就带来了我要的东西！

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
But I still can't remember the rest of the things that I'll be needing. I'm really sorry...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
但我还是想不起还需要哪些东西。真的很抱歉...

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Is there any way to get more of my memory back? In the meantime, let me keep these materials. I promise they'll be used to make a good weapon for you.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
有没有什么办法能让我恢复更多记忆？在此期间，让我先收下这些材料。我保证它们会被用来为你打造一把好武器。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I'll need a lot of materials, but let me remind you of some of
the necessary things that I can actually remember.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我需要很多材料，但让我提醒你一些我确实记得的必要物品。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
So far, I know I'll need
2 Hammer of Blacksmith
1 Emperium Anvil
1 Illusion Flower and
20 Gold.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
目前，我知道我需要
2个高级铁砧
1个华丽金属铁砧
1朵幻想花
和20个金币。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I know there were a few more
things that are crucial to this weapon's construction, but...
I can't seem to concentrate hard enough to remember.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我知道还有几样东西对这把武器的制作至关重要，但是...
我似乎无法集中精神去回忆。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Alright...
I just remembered
most of the things
I need to make you
a great weapon.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
好了...
我终于想起来
制作一把好武器
所需的大部分东西了。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]

scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我觉得有必要告诉你，我无法保证最终会打造出什么样的武器，因为说实话，我也记不清了。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]

2 Hammer of Blacksmith

20 Gold.

1个华丽金属铁砧

scripts.text:
[Kayron]

of mine is beginning to worry me a little bit...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
先把那些物品带给我吧。我确信还需要别的东西，但我就是想不起来。我的记忆开始让我有点担心了...

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Anyway, I'll be waiting for you here while you go out and collect those things. Be careful, alright?
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
总之，我会在这里等你去收集那些东西。小心点，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
In life, I was known as Kayron.
But now I'm just another ghost wandering around this realm of
the dead. Without a body, I feel
so useless.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
生前，人们叫我凯隆。
但现在，我只是在这个死后世界游荡的又一个幽灵。没有身体，我感到自己毫无用处。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
There's nothing I can do.
I'm... Um... I'm...?
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我无能为力。
我...嗯...我是...？

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I'm utterly helpless here.
Right, right! My father always used to say that! I guess my brothers and I take after our father in a lot of ways.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我完全帮不上忙。
没错，没错！我父亲以前总是这么说！我想我和兄弟们在很多方面都像他。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
My mind's been so hazy.
I forgot that I even used
to be a living human.
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我的脑子一直昏昏沉沉的。
我甚至忘了自己曾经是个活生生的人。
^333333*叹息...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Still, that little memory has brought me a little peace of
mind. I really appreciate that.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
不过，这点记忆还是让我稍微安心了一些。真的很感激。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I used to be a weaponsmith
when I was alive, so if you like, I can forge something nice for you. You'll have to bring me the materials, though.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
我生前是个铁匠，所以如果你愿意，我可以为你打造一件不错的装备。不过，你得把材料带给我。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
You understand that being
dead sort of restricts my mobility. Still, it's actually useful to be stuck in Niflheim. This place is filled with some strange energy that will help in my smithing.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
你知道，死了之后行动会受到限制。不过，被困在尼弗海姆其实也有好处。这里弥漫着一种奇怪的能量，对我的锻造很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Even though experimental
smithing got me killed, I won't have to worry about it this time. After all, I'm already dead! Hahahah~
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
虽然实验性锻造让我丢了命，但这次我不用担心了。毕竟，我已经死了！哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Alright, just give me a little time so that I can try to remember the things that I'll need, alright?
scripts.translation:
[凯隆]
好了，给我一点时间，让我试着回忆一下需要哪些东西，好吗？

抱歉，我正在努力回忆我父亲以前常说的一句话...

How...
the hell...?
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
怎...怎么可能...？

活人跑到这里来干什么？留下来吧，我保证你活不了多久。快走吧，你不想变成我这样的。赶紧离开这里！

Damn it...
I didn't want to die!
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
该死...
我不想死啊！

Well, nothing that's alive really wants to die, but I was so close to finishing what I wanted to do. Ah, youth...
scripts.translation:

嗯，活着的生物其实都不想死，但我当时离完成我想做的事只差一步了。啊，青春啊...

Youth...
Enjoy your youth...
I remember hearing
something like that,
but there was more to it...
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
青春...
享受你的青春...

嘿...
感觉你是带着某种目的

没错，漫无目的的人和

这就是...狂暴状态！

这就是...邪灵之矛！

[Reyghema]
I guess the dead aren't supposed to remember their past. But thank you for letting achieve my life long desire, even if this moment is short lived.
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
我想，死者是不该记得过去的。但谢谢你让我实现了毕生的愿望，哪怕这一刻如此短暂。

past so that I can experience the joy of weapon crafting again. Farewell, adventurer...

如果你有机会，请回来帮我找回过去的记忆，让我再次体验打造武器的喜悦。再见了，冒险者...

你身上的那些东西。那是我要打造武器所需的材料！让我看看...

不过你是怎么知道

是时候考验你的运气了。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Nice. You won {0} times. Your luck is really good, so now we're finally finished with this nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
不错。你赢了{0}次。你的运气真好，这下我们总算可以结束这些无聊的事了。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Give me some time to get some things ready. Hand me the ores
now, and talk to me a little later, alright?
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
给我点时间准备一下。现在把矿石交给我，稍后再来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Damn...
I should be happy I won, but that just means your luck is bad and
we need to do this again.
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
该死...
我虽然赢了，但这只能说明你运气太差，
我们还得再来一次。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
I'm sorry, but I'll need to take a bunch of one of your ores to get rid of your bad luck. Come back with all of the ore we'll need so we can test your luck again, alright?
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
抱歉，我需要拿走你身上的一些矿石来消除你的霉运。
请把我们需要的矿石全部带回来，这样我们才能再次测试你的运气，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Arrrgh!
I still can't
remember what
I need yet! I swear,
this is killing me!
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
啊！
我还是想不起来
我需要什么！天哪，
这简直要了我的命！

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
...

[Reyghema]
...
......

[Reyghema]
Damn.
Damn, damn, damn!
'Killing me?!' I'm already dead!
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
该死。
该死，该死，该死！
“要了我的命”？我早就死了！

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Good work, you've brought everything I asked for. However, there's been a bit of a snafu in the plans...
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
干得好，你带齐了我要求的所有东西。不过，计划出现了一点小意外...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
The original plan was that I'd remember everything else I need once you came back with this stuff. But I didn't.
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
原本的计划是，等你带着这些东西回来时，我会想起其他所有需要的东西。但我没有想起来。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Just give me some time to think about it some more. For now, let
me hold on to the things you've brought. You've got my word that I'll be using these to make a weapon for you.
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
请给我点时间再想想。暂时先让我保管你带来的这些东西吧。
我向你保证，我会用它们为你打造一把武器。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
I better remind
you what things I'll
be needing. If you need
to, write it all down.
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
我得提醒你一下我需要哪些东西。
如果你需要的话，把它们都记下来。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
1 Emperium Anvil,
2 Hammer of Blacksmith,
1 Illusion Flower
and 20 Gold...
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
1个华丽金属铁砧，
2个高级铁砧，
1朵幻想花
和20个金币...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
There were a few more critically important things, but I can't seem to recall them right now...
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
还有几样至关重要的东西，但我现在怎么也想不起来了...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Alright, you're back. I remember most of the things I'll be needing. Go ahead and note this down.
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
好了，你回来了。我想起了大部分需要的东西。请把这些记下来。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
1 Emperium Anvil,
2 Hammer of Blacksmith,
1 Illusion Flower
and 20 Gold...
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
1个华丽金属铁砧，
2个高级铁砧，
1朵幻想花
和20个金币...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
There were a few other
important things, but I can't seem to remember what they were. Hopefully, by the time you come back with the items I'll know by then.
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
还有几样重要的东西，但我实在想不起来是什么了。
希望等你带着物品回来时，我就能想起来了。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
For now, just go and bring back the things I asked for. The sooner, the better. Hurry, I don't know how long my memories will last...
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
现在，先去把我要求的东西带回来吧。越快越好。
快去吧，我不知道我的记忆还能维持多久...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Damn it...
I didn't want to die!
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
该死...
我不想死啊！

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Well, nothing that's alive really wants to die, but I was so close to finishing what I wanted to do. Ah, youth...

[雷格玛]

Enjoy your youth...
I remember hearing

[Reyghema]

.......
Enjoy your youth.
Live without regret.
scripts.translation:

...
.......
享受你的青春。
活得无怨无悔。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Of course...
My father, Bill Thayer used to say that all the time! That's right!
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
当然...
我的父亲，比尔·塞耶以前总是这么说！没错！

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Hey you, thanks for refreshing my memory. It's all coming back to me. I used to be a weaponsmith, but I regret never finishing my final project...
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
嘿，谢谢你帮我找回了记忆。一切都想起来了。
我曾经是一名武器匠，但我遗憾地没有完成我的最后一个项目...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
You just gotta help me realize
my final goal. Even if I am dead,
I really wanna complete the experiment that got me killed.
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
你只需要帮我实现最后的愿望。
即使我已经死了，
我也真的想完成那个导致我死亡的实验。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
All you need to do for now is bring me the things I need. I don't think I'll be able to gather much, being here in Niflheim and all.
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
现在你只需要把需要的东西带给我。
既然我身处尼弗海姆，我想我也无法收集到多少东西了。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Come back a little later.
By then, I should remember what kinds of things I'll need.
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
请稍后再来。
到时候，我应该就能想起自己需要哪些东西了。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
What...?
You playin' games
with me or what?
Get outta my face~
scripts.translation:
[雷格玛]
什么...？
你在耍我吗？
离我远点~

scripts.text:

Damn it...
I didn't want to die!

scripts.text:
[Hein]
It looks like you want to ask me something. Heh, my customers used to have that look on that faces too when I worked as a weaponsmith...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
看起来你好像有什么事想问我。呵呵，我以前当武器匠的时候，顾客们露出这种表情时，通常也是有什么事要拜托我...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Back during those days,
I never accepted money for my work. Father always used to say, 'Never accept payment to forge a good weapon. It... It...'
scripts.translation:
[海因]
在那段日子里，
我从不收取工钱。神父总是说，
“打造好武器，绝不能收取报酬。它...它...”

[Hein]

Why can't I remember the
rest of that saying?!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
后面是什么来着？
为什么我想不起来
那句话的后半段了？！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
It's so weird.
How could I forget
something I used to
say all the time? I...
I hate being dead!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
真奇怪。
我以前经常说的话，
怎么会忘记呢？我...
我讨厌死亡！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Nuts! Why can't I remember
the rest of that saying?!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
该死！为什么我想不起来
那句话的后半段？！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Mm? I can tell you've here because you've got something to do. It's weird enough to see a living being here, and weirder still to see one who's here for a good reason.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嗯？我知道你来到这里，是因为你有事要做。在这里见到活人已经够奇怪了，而带着正当理由来的活人就更奇怪了。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Do me a favor
and stay alive.
Take it from me,
there's no pleasure
at all in being dead.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
帮我个忙，
好好活着。
相信我，
死亡没有任何乐趣可言。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
You're here!
I just finished my work!
You want to see it, don't you?
Now, take a deep breath...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
你来了！
我刚完成作品！
你想看看，对吧？
现在，深呼吸...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Haha~!
This is great!
Finally, my life's
work is complete!
This weapon's name
is Edge!
scripts.translation:
[海因]

太棒了！
终于，我毕生的
作品完成了！
这把武器的名字
是“Edge”！

[Hein]
Well...
It looks like this is goodbye for now. I can already feel my memory getting hazier. Haha, being dead is definitely not good.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嗯...
看来现在要告别了。我已经感觉到记忆变得模糊了。哈哈，死亡确实不好。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Thank you for your help. If you come back and help me retrieve
my memories again, I'll try to help you as well. So long, adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
谢谢你的帮助。如果你回来帮我找回记忆，我也会尽力帮助你。再见，冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Mm...?
The stuff you brought seems to be just what I need to finish my work. Let me have a look at them...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嗯...？
你带来的东西似乎正是我完成作品所需的。让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Wow...
How did you know the materials
I needed? It's almost too good to be true! Alright, we're that much closer to finishing my life's work!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
哇...
你怎么知道我需要这些材料？
简直好得难以置信！好吧，我们离完成毕生作品又近了一步！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Oh, that's right. Skill alone isn't enough to create this. We'll also need your luck. First of all, we need to test if your luck is good today.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
哦，对了。光靠技术是不够的，还需要你的运气。首先，我们要测试一下你今天运气好不好。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
We're going to play '^660000Rock, Paper, Scissors^000000.' If you win at least 2 out of 3, we'll go ahead and start crafting this thing!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
我们要玩“^660000石头、剪刀、布^000000”。如果你赢下至少2局（共3局），我们就开始打造这件东西！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
But if you fail in this game, I'll have to expel your negative luck by throwing out a lot of one of the ores you've brought along.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
但如果你输了，我就得把你带来的矿石扔掉一些，以驱散你的霉运。

When I tell you to, write down 'Rock,' 'Paper' or 'Scissors.' I'll do the same thing, and we'll compare our results at the end, okay? Let's begin!

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Let's see...
You won {0} times.
You're really good at game!
Yes, your luck is at its highest!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
让我看看...
你赢了{0}次。
你真的很擅长玩游戏！
是的，你的运气好到了极点！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
As promised, I will craft a weapon for you. Give me the materials now, and come back when I'm finished preparing.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
如我所承诺的，我会为你打造一把武器。现在把材料给我，等我准备好后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Well, you lost.
I'm sorry, but we
need to expel the
misfortune around you
with the ore you've brought...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嗯，你输了。
很抱歉，我们需要用你带来的矿石
来驱散你身边的厄运...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Okay, I'll wait here.
Come back with the materials
I need and we'll try this again.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
好的，我会在这里等着。
带着我需要的材料回来，我们再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Would you give me more time to remember the materials? I can't seem to focus very well. It might have to do with the fact that I'm dead...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
你能给我多一点时间回忆一下材料吗？我似乎无法集中注意力。这也许是因为我已经死了...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
I had a much better memory when I was alive I'm sure. My father would quiz me on this stuff all the time...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
我相信我活着的时候记忆力要好得多。我父亲总是考我这些东西...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Hey, you brought everything I asked for already. You must be ready to get started!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嘿，你已经把我要求的所有东西都带来了。看来你准备好开始了！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Sadly, we can't begin until
I remember the rest of the things we need. I can't for the life of me remember the most important materials...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
遗憾的是，在我记起我们需要的所有东西之前，我们无法开始。我无论如何也想不起最重要的材料...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Well, for now, let me keep the things you've brought to me. I promise that I'll use this stuff to make you a good weapon once everything is ready.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
那么，暂时先把你带来的东西留在我这里吧。我保证，等一切准备就绪，我会用这些材料为你打造一把好武器。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
For sure I'll need
2 Hammer of Blacksmith,
1 Emperium Anvil,
1 Illusion Flower and
20 Gold...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
我肯定需要
2个高级铁砧，
1个华丽金属铁砧，
1朵幻想花和
20个金币...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
So for now,
go ahead and
bring that stuff
to me, please.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
所以暂时，
请把这些东西
带给我。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
I take it that you
really want me to make
you a weapon. For a former
weaponsmith like me, that in
itself is a great compliment.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
看来你真的很想让我为你打造一把武器。对于像我这样曾经的武器匠来说，这本身就是一种极大的赞美。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Alright, I'll need...
1 Emperium Anvil,
2 Hammer of Blacksmith,
1 Illusion Flower and
20 Gold...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
好的，我需要...
1个华丽金属铁砧，
2个高级铁砧，
1朵幻想花和
20个金币...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
There were 3 other things,
but I'm not too sure what they were. I guess a bunch of memories from my life are still missing.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
还有另外3样东西，
但我不太确定是什么。我想我生命中的一些记忆仍然缺失。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
^333333*Sigh*^000000 I'm sorry to ask this of you, but would you please go out and figure out what those things are? I'm sure you can find some clue in the land of the living.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
^333333*叹气*^000000 很抱歉要麻烦你，但你能不能出去弄清楚那些东西是什么？我相信你在生者的国度一定能找到一些线索。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
While you do that, I'll try my best to remember what else I need to make this weapon.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
在你做这件事的时候，我会尽力回忆打造这把武器还需要什么。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
It looks like you want to ask me something. Heh, my customers used to have that look on that faces too when I worked as a weaponsmith...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
看起来你好像有什么事想问我。呵呵，我以前当武器匠的时候，顾客们露出这种表情时，通常也是有什么事要拜托我...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Back during those days,
I never accepted money for my work. Father always used to say, 'Never accept payment to forge a good weapon. It... It...'
scripts.translation:
[海因]
在那段日子里，
我从不收取工钱。神父总是说，
“打造好武器，绝不能收取报酬。它...它...”

scripts.text:
[Hein]
That's right!
And you need luck when you're creating high quality weapons!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
没错！
而且打造高品质武器时，你还需要运气！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Oh... crap.
I'm a dead man.
I just realized.
Or remembered.
Perhaps I'm brain
dead too, huh?
scripts.translation:
[海因]
噢...糟糕。
我死定了。
我刚刚才意识到。
或者说想起来了。
也许我的脑子也死掉了吧？

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Well, I must be a lucky dead man for remembering some of my past, right? Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嗯，既然能想起过去的一些事，我肯定是个幸运的死人吧？哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Right, I died while trying to finish my weapon research. Maybe this is fate's way of allowing me to finish my uncompleted work?
scripts.translation:
[海因]
对了，我是在试图完成武器研究时死的。也许这是命运允许我完成未竟之业？

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Hey, let me ask you a favor. Would you bring the materials I need to finish my research? If I succeed, the finished product is yours to keep. All yours!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嘿，让我求你个忙。你能帮我带齐完成研究所需的材料吗？如果成功，成品归你所有。全归你！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Take your time
and think about it.
It can't be that bad
of a deal... Right?
scripts.translation:
[海因]
慢慢考虑吧。
这交易应该不亏...对吧？

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Wha...?
What are you talking about?
What was I going to say?
Oww... My head hurts!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
什...么？
你在说什么？
我刚才想说什么来着？
哎哟...头好痛！

scripts.text:

我从不收取工钱。神父总是说，
“打造好武器，绝不能收取报酬。它...它...”

scripts.text:
[Hein]
What was the rest of it?
Why can't I remember the
rest of that saying?!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
后面是什么来着？
为什么我想不起来
那句话的后半段了？！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
It's so weird.
How could I forget
something I used to
say all the time? I...
I hate being dead!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
真奇怪。
我以前经常说的话，
怎么会忘记呢？我...
我讨厌死亡！

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Hah...!
A living person!
But not for long!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特博格斯特]
哈...！
活人！
但你也活不了多久了！

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
I hope you came here with some strong allies. Judging from your strength, there's no way you'll survive in this kind of place on
your own, you know.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特博格斯特]
我希望你带了强力盟友过来。以你的实力，在这种地方独自生存是不可能的，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
It's so frustrating being dead.
I can't do anything without a body, no matter how hard I try.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特博格斯特]
死了真让人沮丧。
没有身体，无论怎么努力都什么都做不了。

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
It's funny, you know. My father always used to say, 'Trying your best won't always result in success...' Um, that's ... Huh? There was more, I think.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特博格斯特]
说来好笑，你知道吗。我父亲常说，“尽力未必能成功...”嗯，后面是...咦？后面还有话，我想。

scripts.text: Show interest.
scripts.translation: 表示感兴趣

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Let me try it again.
'Trying your best won't
always result in success...'
I'm sure that's not all of it...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特博格斯特]
让我再试一次。
“尽力未必能成功...”
肯定不止这些...

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
I...
I can't think!
What was supposed
to come after that part?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特博格斯特]
我...
我想不起来了！
后面那句话是什么来着？

scripts.text:

'Trying your best won't
always result in success...'
I'm sure that's not all of it...
scripts.translation:

让我再试一次。
“尽力未必能成功...”
肯定不止这些...

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
It doesn't look like you're just wandering around. You're here for something specific, aren't you? But what does the realm of the dead have to offer the living?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特博格斯特]
看起来你不像是随便逛逛的。你是有特定目的才来的，对吧？但亡灵国度能给活人提供什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Take a look at this!
In just a short time, I made something with the materials you've given me. You're curious what the result is, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特博格斯特]
看看这个！
只用了一小会儿，我就用你给我的材料做出了东西。你很好奇结果是什么，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Waltboughst never fails!
With my skill and your luck, there was zero probability for failure. Behold... Byeollungum!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔特博格斯特]
沃尔特博格斯特从不失败！
凭借我的技艺和你的运气，失败率为零。请看...首领之剑！

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Waltboughst never fails!
With my skill and your luck, there was zero probability for failure. Behold... Exorcise!
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

It's so frustrating being dead.
I can't do anything without a body, no matter how hard I try.
scripts.translation:

死了真让人沮丧。
没有身体，无论怎么努力都什么都做不了。

Every successful man in
history has tried his best!
scripts.translation:

但这不是借口！
历史上每一个成功人士

嘿嘿，不过这次不会了！
